# Case Broker

> Case Broker matches people with legal matters to regulator-verified UK law firms for video consultations, so clients can compare fees, experience, reviews and awards.

## Pages

- [Home](https://casebroker.co.uk/): Submit a legal matter and get matched with specialist firms.
- [Law Firms](https://casebroker.co.uk/firms): Browse verified firms by practice area.
- [Pricing](https://casebroker.co.uk/pricing): Plans for law firms.
- [About](https://casebroker.co.uk/about): Our mission and how the platform works.
- [FAQs](https://casebroker.co.uk/faqs): Common questions from clients and firms.
- [Blog](https://casebroker.co.uk/blog): Legal guides and insights.

## Optional

- [Help Center](https://casebroker.co.uk/help): Support guides.
- [Privacy Policy](https://casebroker.co.uk/privacy): How personal data is handled.
- [Terms of Service](https://casebroker.co.uk/terms): Platform terms.
